Hu Bushuai's gaze swept past A-Cheng and A-Dai, and then he felt a gust of wind sweep past his side; Shang Feifan had already charged to the very front.

The mount rest area was in absolute chaos.

"Who is it! Who laid the poison? Get out here! I want you to pay with your life!"

"Ahhh, my giant insect mount is dead! And this is a giant insect that can fly! Do you know how hard it is to get a flying giant insect mount like this? Your market must compensate me!"

"Who provided today's food and water? Bring them here!"

"Your market must take responsibility! No one can escape!"

"What is your Mo Luo City playing at? We came here to buy potions, and you actually let someone poison our giant insect partners to death? Let me tell you, this isn't over!"

"Everyone, let's talk things through properly; don't argue and don't fight! We will make sure to investigate this matter thoroughly. The security squad is arriving immediately, and the coroner will be here as well. We will definitely give everyone an explanation!"

The person in charge of the rest area was shouting through a megaphone, the surroundings a complete racket.

"Zhen Ye!" Shang Feifan called out.

A severed-wing giant beetle, a full circle larger in size than any of the other giant insects, clacked its way out of the rest area, its long legs gently poking Shang Feifan's arm.

Shang Feifan let out a breath. The two-month journey had made him realize the importance of Zhen Ye over and over again. Without Zhen Ye, he had no idea what monkey year or horse month it would be before he could reach Mo Luo City, especially while carrying a cub and a marten-beastman with minimal combat power.

"Are you alright?" Shang Feifan asked, rubbing his lips.

"Clack, clack, clack," Zhen Ye signaled in its blocky manner that it had only just arrived and hadn't yet had the chance to drink the water or eat the food here before it smelled that several giant insects had died.

Shang Feifan patted Zhen Ye, reminding it not to consume the food and water here for the time being.

Zhen Ye tapped its claw tips to make two clacking sounds.

Shang Feifan knew Zhen Ye's vigilance was top-notch, and it could communicate with other giant insects. As long as it knew the dead giant insects were related to the food and water here, no matter how much those provisions suited its palate, it would never touch them.

Hu Bushuai had also rushed over and was checking on his own giant insect mount.

The other beastmen were doing the same.

Shang Feifan led Zhen Ye to Hu Bushuai's side.

Hu Bushuai's expression was exceptionally grim as he dropped to one knee before his giant insect.

His giant insect mount was dead.

As more and more beastmen rushed over, the surrounding situation grew even more chaotic.

There was more than one or two poisoned giant insects; the market was in deep trouble.

Sweat poured from the head and body of the beastman in charge of the apothecary market's rest area as he desperately tried to explain to the beastmen who had lost their giant insect mounts. But the grieving beastmen refused to listen at all, single-mindedly demanding that the apothecary market pay the price and hand over the person who administered the poison.

The security patrol arrived, separated the beastmen, and ordered unrelated beastmen to leave immediately.

Shang Feifan hadn't expected Hu Bushuai to be one of the unlucky victims who fell into the trap.

In this situation, no matter how one offered comfort, it wouldn't be appropriate.

"You might just have been dragged into some revenge plot. I'll help you track down the poisoner and avenge your giant insect." Shang Feifan patted Hu Bushuai.

Hu Bushuai didn't speak; he suspected that the poisoner was aiming directly at him.

This made Hu Bushuai nearly unable to suppress the raging fury rising in his heart.

He had avoided and evaded to the utmost, even taking the initiative to leave Moyao Valley Town, precisely to avoid contact with those people who came looking for him, hoping his evasive actions would put certain people at ease.

Yet... perhaps his uncle was right: as long as he was alive, certain people would never truly feel at ease.

There were also those who didn't dare to actually kill him, yet could conjure up all sorts of methods to disgust him and harass him, harboring a perverted psychological mindset that as long as you were unhappy, they were happy.

Hu Bushuai lowered his eyelids, drawing a slow breath to calm his inner anger.

He needed to investigate this matter thoroughly and figure out whether what he had encountered was an undeserved catastrophe, or if he himself was the source.

Looking at the emotionally restrained Hu Bushuai, Shang Feifan sighed inwardly.

Sometimes, it was better to vent anger and grief; internalizing that stress was no good thing.

Just thinking about the dead giant insect being Zhen Ye allowed him to feel just how heartbroken and furious Hu Bushuai must be right now.

Shang Feifan wanted to pat and stroke the other man's shoulder.

Hu Bushuai dodged the gesture and stood up by himself.

The apothecary market magistrate was tallying up the total number of dead giant insects.

Over by the troughs and water basins, people were already taking samples to test for poison.

This was the City of Apothecaries; their reaction to a poisoning incident was much swifter than other cases.

Another security patrol was added, and the rubbernecking beastmen were dispersed, leaving only the owners of the victimized giant insects and other related parties.

"Is this dead giant insect yours?" A magistrate holding a leather notebook and a pen walked over to inquire.

"Yes," Hu Bushuai replied.

"Are you a merchant? Where did you come from?" The magistrate first asked for Hu Bushuai's name and background, then proceeded to check his identity bone tablet.

"I'm not a merchant; I just came here to procure potions with my family." Hu Bushuai pulled out a bone tablet and handed it to the magistrate.

"Moyao Valley Town under Golden Wheat City? That's not close to us at all." The magistrate looked up at Hu Bushuai.

Hu Bushuai's gaze was calm: "In past years, merchant caravans would bring medicine to our town, but this year's caravan never came. As luck would have it, an epidemic broke out in a beastman gathering place near our town, and we had no choice but to come out and buy medicine ourselves."

"An epidemic?" The magistrate's look toward Hu Bushuai changed.

Hu Bushuai: "It hasn't spread to our town yet. Our town has already blocked off the road leading from that settlement to ours. Our town head only had us come purchase anti-epidemic potions and wound medicine as a precaution."

Hu Bushuai paused, then added, "If we had contracted the epidemic, it would have flared up on our way here. Similarly, if we had contracted the epidemic, I wouldn't proactively tell you about it."

The magistrate thought to himself that made sense. Factoring in the distance from Golden Wheat City to here, he felt much more at ease.

"Does this epidemic affect giant insects?" the magistrate asked again.

Shang Feifan abruptly chimed in: "Aren't all these dead giant insects poisoned to death? Even if the owners of these giant insects come from various places, supposing one giant insect contracted an epidemic, there's no way it could infect and kill all the other giant insects the moment it made contact, right?"

The magistrate looked at Shang Feifan: "And you are?"

"Norman Hocheil, from Black Forest City." Shang Feifan had already decided to make use of the real Norman's identity. He fished out the identity bone tablet and handed it to the magistrate.

Seeing the information displayed on the identity card, the magistrate's expression shifted slightly.

Shang Feifan lowered his voice: "Please keep my identity confidential."

The magistrate frowned tightly, looked left and right, and also lowered his voice: "Are you here to investigate something in our city? Could this poisoning incident..."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第39章 我和拉斐尔有特殊关系 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
商非凡面色严肃：“情况不明，请不要妄加猜测。投毒的事就先按照普通投毒调查。当然，如果方便，我希望能跟进这个案件的调查情况。”

治安官犹豫片刻：“这事我做不了主。如果你想跟进案情，得获得我们督查同意。”

“你们督查在哪里？我很乐意去拜访他。他是专门负责这片街区吗？”

“是。我们这里按照街区划分职责。我们督查专门负责第六街，也是药剂市场这一片，他现在就在街角的治安办公楼里。”

治安官又转看向虎不帅：“在事情调查清楚之前，请你和你的同伴暂时不要离开摩罗城。另外，我们会随时前往你居住的地方询问一些情况，请和我们保持联系。”

虎不帅也不想为难这些办事的治安人员，脾气很好地点头，表示知道。

治安官刚才被好几个兽人吼了，他的搭档也正在安抚其他暴怒兽人，故而他对能保持冷静，态度还温和的虎不帅很有好感。对虎不帅行了个礼，又对商非凡点点头，继续去询问其他巨虫主人。

虎不帅看到商非凡收起那枚眼熟的身份骨牌，一时不知道是不是该直接说破自己的身份。

商非凡正好侧头看他，“怎么？”

虎不帅摇头，语含深意地：“没什么。只是我没想到你竟然真的是一名特别调查员。你这是不打算对我隐瞒了吗？修理商先生。”

“哈！我也没想隐瞒，只是不想你误会我是来监视你和你姨父的。如果我能在莫约镇多待一段时间，肯定会和你说明我的身份。”商非凡笑，转而就问：“莫约镇附近发生了什么疫病？距离莫约镇有多远？”

“初步判断是痢疾。止泻药没有多大用处。”虎不帅看着商非凡的眼睛：“发生疫病的地方你也熟悉，就是莫约山谷口那个寨子。”

“那不是离莫约镇很近？”商非凡看到虎不帅脸上表情，脑中迅速闪过什么，“这次疫病非正常发生？有人故意用疫病感染那个寨子里的兽人？”

“这件事镇长还在调查。”虎不帅没有给出明确答案。

但商非凡只看他神情就知道他的猜测八-九不离十。

原本他以为巨虫投毒事件只是偶然，虎不帅只是倒霉地撞上，但现在……

虎不帅忽然道：“你到莫约镇是要调查什么事情吗？还是要找什么人？”

商非凡想到那封信的内容，斟酌着说道：“实际上我确实和人约好要在莫约山谷见面。”

“哦？是谁？是当地人吗？也许我认识。”

商非凡：“是一个和我关系比较特殊的人，我和他……情况比较复杂。”

虎不帅：我怎么不知道我和你关系特殊，还复杂到让你如此纠结。

商非凡想着信件开头第一句话，总觉得那个调查官和那个叫拉斐尔的人有不清不楚的暧昧关系，否则谁会在信件也许是日记的开头第一句，就特特写明“我和拉斐尔XX先生有X殊关系”。

虽然开头第一句沾了一些血迹，污染了一些词语，但整句话的大意还是明明白白。

商非凡想着自己既然冒充了人家身份，自然要扮演好这个身份，于是就说道：“那人叫拉斐尔，我和他……我们都是成年人，你明白吧。”

虎不帅面无表情：我不明白。

商非凡用他的复杂神情演绎出了无数内涵，最后一摊手：“总之，我和他约好了在莫约山谷见面，但我还没有见到他，就被人诅咒，然后……你也看到了。”

虎不帅顾不上在心里吐槽，他一肚子疑问，这时就顺势问了出来：“我是看到了。所以你当时是被召唤了，还是被传送走了？你又是怎么在诅咒中活下来的？你现在……诅咒已经消散了吧？”

商非凡走近一步，特意压低声音：“这关系到我的神血天赋。只有我最亲近最信任的人才能知道。”

虎不帅感觉到虎兽人身上传来的热气，下意识往后退了一步，开玩笑地说：“比如那个拉斐尔？”

商非凡意味深长地笑：“是啊，我的拉斐尔可以知道。”

虎不帅：你的拉斐尔？

原本虎不帅还想挑破自己的身份，但现在他决定打死也不会说破，他不想尴尬得脚趾抠地。

商非凡还伸手戳人家胳膊，带着一点点亲昵地问：“你有见过我的拉斐尔吗？他是不是就在你们镇子上？”

虎不帅：等回去我就告诉我姨父一家，让他们彻底遗忘掉拉斐尔郎沐这个名字！

“不帅？”

“……我没见过你的拉斐尔。”虎不帅在“你的”代称上面加重语气。

商非凡没有发现华点，还在笑：“心情好一点了吗？”

虎不帅愣住。

商非凡搭住青年的肩膀，“我们会找到投毒者，不管他是谁，也一定会让他付出代价！”

虎不帅不习惯和人这么亲近，想要挣脱商非凡的手。

但商非凡的手劲很大，他自己还没有自觉，虎不帅一时竟然没能挣脱。

“并不是所有案件都能找到凶手。就算能找到投毒者，也不一定能找到真正的指使者。”虎不帅为了缓解不自在，快速说道。

商非凡强行转过他的身体：“你是不是知道什么？这件事是针对你来的吗？”

虎不帅深吸气：“我不知道。”

商非凡盯着虎不帅的眼睛看，他在想虎不帅在隐瞒什么，是否和他那个“私生子”身份有关。

但私生子这种事太戳人心管子，他总不能直接问虎不帅：是不是人家正室或正室子女想要搞你？

“伤害你的人都会付出代价。没有人可以躲在后面偷笑，越是想要看你笑话的人越会倒霉。”商非凡按住青年的肩膀，无比认真地说道。

虎不帅：“……谢谢。”

虽然只是常见的安慰，但他承认他还是被安慰到了。

法医拎着药箱过来，他要给巨虫做解剖，好明确死因。

虎不帅不肯离开，就看着法医动手。

商非凡跟他打了声招呼，先回去那家药剂店把阿呆和阿城接了过来。

虎不帅看到阿呆扑进商非凡怀里，还叫他爸爸，有点好奇。

“这是你儿子？”

商非凡无奈：“他不是我儿子，他只是喜欢叫我爸爸，就一个赖皮货。”

阿呆纹丝-不动。

虎不帅失笑，他无意去搞清楚这一大一小的真正关系。他只是因为商非凡的身份才会比较在意这个人，但这位似乎到现在都没有认出他就是拉斐尔郎沐，还认为他和他有……成年人的特殊关系，就很古怪。

阿呆仰头看虎不帅。

虎不帅觉得阿呆有点可爱，伸手轻轻摸了摸他的方脑袋：“他叫什么名字？”

“阿呆。大名还没取，等他以后找到他爸妈，让他爸妈取。这是阿城，本地人，跟我一起顺路回来。他家就住在第五街。”商非凡又简单介绍阿城。

阿城对虎不帅腼腆地笑笑。

虎不帅礼貌点头。

“我看这边处理还要一些时间，就快中午了，我请你吃饭。你看，我们也要吃，就加你一个人而已。”商非凡对虎不帅热情邀约。
chunks.englishText:
CHAPTER 39: I Have a Special Relationship with Raphael (Part 2)

Shang Feifan's expression turned stern. "The situation is unclear, please do not jump to conclusions. For now, investigate the poisoning as a routine case of poisoning. Of course, if convenient, I hope to follow up on the investigation of this case."

The magistrate hesitated for a moment. "I can't make the call on this. If you want to follow the case, you'll have to get the consent of our inspector."

"Where is your inspector? I'd be very happy to pay him a visit. Is he specifically in charge of this district?"

"Yes. Here, responsibilities are divided by districts. Our inspector is exclusively in charge of Sixth Street, which is the apothecary market area. He's currently at the security office building on the street corner."

The magistrate turned back to Hu Bushuai. "Before the matter is investigated thoroughly, please refrain from leaving Mo Luo City with your companions. Additionally, we may visit your residence at any time to inquire about certain details, so please keep in contact with us."

Not wishing to make things difficult for these working security personnel, Hu Bushuai nodded with a good temper, indicating he understood.

Having just been yelled at by several beastmen, and with his partner currently pacifying other enraged beastmen, the magistrate felt a strong fondness for Hu Bushuai, who had stayed calm and maintained a mild attitude. He saluted Hu Bushuai, nodded to Shang Feifan, and continued questioning other giant insect owners.

Seeing Shang Feifan put away that familiar identity bone token, Hu Bushuai momentarily wondered whether he should just blow his cover and reveal his true identity.

Shang Feifan happened to turn his head to look at him. "What is it?"

Hu Bushuai shook his head with a profound look in his eyes. "Nothing. I just didn't expect you to actually be a special investigator. Are you planning not to hide it from me anymore, Mr. Repairman?"

"Ha! I never planned to hide it, I just didn't want you to misunderstand that I was here to monitor you and your uncle. If I had been able to stay in Moyao Town a bit longer, I definitely would have explained my identity to you," Shang Feifan laughed, then pivoted to ask, "What epidemic broke out near Moyao Town? How far is it from the town?"

"Preliminary judgment is dysentery. Anti-diarrheal medicine hasn't been of much use." Hu Bushuai looked into Shang Feifan's eyes. "You're familiar with the place where the epidemic broke out, too—it's that stockade at the entrance of Moyao Valley."

"Isn't that very close to Moyao Town?" Seeing the expression on Hu Bushuai's face, something flashed rapidly across Shang Feifan's mind. "This epidemic didn't happen naturally? Someone intentionally infected the beastmen in that stockade with the plague?"

"The mayor is still investigating this matter," Hu Bushuai didn't give a definitive answer.

Yet, just by looking at his expression, Shang Feifan knew his guess was eight or nine parts out of ten correct.

Originally, he had thought the giant insect poisoning incident was merely an accident and Hu Bushuai had just unluckily run into it, but now...

Hu Bushuai suddenly asked, "What are you investigating by coming to Moyao Town? Or are you looking for someone?"

Thinking of the contents of that letter, Shang Feifan weighed his words. "Actually, I indeed have an appointment to meet someone in Moyao Valley."

"Oh? Who is it? A local? Maybe I know them."

Shang Feifan: "It's someone I share a rather special relationship with. He and I... our situation is a bit complicated."

Hu Bushuai: *How come I didn't know I had a special relationship with you, and one so complicated it leaves you this tangled up?*

Thinking of the very first sentence at the beginning of the letter, Shang Feifan always felt that that investigator had some unclear, ambiguous relationship with a person named Raphael. Otherwise, who would specifically write out at the very beginning of a letter—perhaps a diary—"I have a sp**ial relationship with Mr. Raphael L'Mu"?

Although the opening sentence was stained with some blood and a few words were blurred, the general meaning of the whole sentence remained crystal clear.

Thinking that since he was impersonating the guy's identity, he naturally ought to play the role well, Shang Feifan accordingly said, "That person's name is Raphael, and he and I... we're both adults, you understand."

Hu Bushuai, expressionless: *I don't understand.*

Shang Feifan used his complex expression to portray countless connotations before finally throwing up his hands. "Anyway, we made an appointment to meet in Moyao Valley, but before I could see him, I got cursed, and then... well, you saw."

Hu Bushuai couldn't spare the effort to complain inwardly. With a stomach full of questions, he went ahead and asked, "I did see. So you were summoned back then, or were you teleported away? And how on earth did you survive the curse? Right now... the curse has dissipated, hasn't it?"

Shang Feifan stepped closer, lowering his voice intentionally: "That relates to my divine-blood talent. Only the person closest and most trusted by me can know."

Feeling the body heat radiating from the tiger beastman, Hu Bushuai instinctively took a step back and joked, "For instance, that Raphael?"

Shang Feifan smiled meaningfully. "Yeah, my Raphael is allowed to know."

Hu Bushuai: *Your Raphael?*

Originally, Hu Bushuai had wanted to puncture his own disguise, but right now he decided he would rather die than expose it; he didn't want to cringe hard enough to claw out a three-bedroom apartment with his toes.

Shang Feifan even reached out to poke the other's arm, asking with a trace of intimacy, "Have you seen my Raphael? Is he right there in your town?"

Hu Bushuai: *Once I get back, I'll tell my uncle's family to completely erase the name Raphael L'Mu from existence!*

"Bushuai?"

"...I haven't seen your Raphael," Hu Bushuai emphasized the "your" pronoun.

Failing to notice the subtle punchline, Shang Feifan was still smiling. "Are you feeling a bit better?"

Hu Bushuai froze.

Shang Feifan hooked an arm around the young man's shoulder. "We'll find the poisoner. Whoever they are, we'll definitely make them pay the price!"

Not used to being so close to someone, Hu Bushuai tried to shake off Shang Feifan's hand.

However, Shang Feifan's grip strength was considerable—something he hadn't realized himself—and for a moment, Hu Bushuai actually failed to break free.

"Not every case can find a culprit. Even if we find the poisoner, we might not necessarily find the real mastermind," Hu Bushuai said quickly to ease his awkwardness.

Shang Feifan forcefully turned his body around. "Do you know something? Is this incident directed at you?"

Hu Bushuai took a deep breath. "I don't know."

Shang Feifan stared straight into Hu Bushuai's eyes, wondering what Hu Bushuai was hiding and whether it had anything to do with his "illegitimate child" status.

Yet, illegitimate child matters struck too close to the bone; he couldn't just directly ask Hu Bushuai: *Is the principal wife or the principal wife's children trying to screw you over?*

"Everyone who hurt you will pay the price. No one gets to hide in the back and laugh. The more they want to watch you make a fool of yourself, the more miserable they'll end up," Shang Feifan pressed down on the young man's shoulders, speaking with utmost earnestness.

Hu Bushuai: "...Thank you."

Though it was just common comfort, he admitted he was still comforted by it.

The coroner walked over carrying a medical kit; he needed to perform an autopsy on the giant insects to pinpoint the cause of death.

Refusing to leave, Hu Bushuai watched the coroner go to work.

Shang Feifan bid him a brief greeting, then walked back to the apothecary shop to fetch A-Dai and A-Cheng.

Seeing A-Dai pounce into Shang Feifan's arms and call him "Dad," Hu Bushuai felt a bit curious.

"Is this your son?"

Shang Feifan smiled helplessly. "He's not my son; he just likes calling me Dad. He's just a little freeloader."

A-Dai remained completely motionless.

Hu Bushuai chuckled. He had no intention of sorting out the true relationship between this adult and child. He only cared about this person because of Shang Feifan's identity. But the fact that this fellow still hadn't recognized him as Raphael L'Mu up to this point, and instead thought that he and him shared... an adult special relationship, was just too bizarre.

A-Dai looked up at Hu Bushuai.

Finding A-Dai rather cute, Hu Bushuai reached out and gently patted his square head. "What's his name?"

"A-Dai. He doesn't have a formal given name yet; I'll wait until he finds his parents in the future and let them pick it. This is A-Cheng, a local who's traveling back along the same road with me. His family lives right on Fifth Street," Shang Feifan briefly introduced A-Cheng in turn.

A-Cheng gave Hu Bushuai a shy smile.

Hu Bushuai nodded politely.

"I see it'll take some more time to handle things here, and it's almost noon. Let me treat you to a meal. Look, we have to eat anyway, so adding just one more person is nothing." Shang Feifan enthusiastically invited Hu Bushuai.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第39章 我和拉斐尔有特殊关系 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
阿城：好吧，我不急。反正已经到家门口了。

虎不帅看着巨虫伙伴的尸体，摇头：“我这边还有很多事要处理。你也有自己的事情要办吧？”

商非凡很想陪着虎不帅，但……转头看了看阿城。

有这位在，他和不帅确实有很多话都不方便说，那还是先把这个电灯泡解决掉好了。

阿城觉得自己被嫌弃了，而且他有证据。

“你现在住在哪里？等我办完事情，我去找你。我还要回莫约镇，正好和你一起走。”商非凡十分坦然地说。

他现在还没想着要泡虎不帅，但他也确实很想和这个NPC多待一会儿，他决定从心。

虎不帅想说他不会那么快回去莫约镇，但看到站在一边的阿城，他把要说的话咽了回去，改口：“我们人多，还有一些货物，在第九街租了一个院子，门牌号码是……”

商非凡记下地址，和虎不帅约好晚上见面。

走前，商非凡突然转身，快速拥抱了一下虎不帅。

虎不帅冷不防地被他抱住，还没挣扎就被对方松开，一时都不知道该用什么表情面对这位热情的虎兽人。

阿呆被挤在两人中间，方脸蛋都被挤扁了。

虎不帅目光和阿呆相撞，看到了彼此眼中对某个成年人的无语。

商非凡对虎不帅摆摆手，抱着阿呆跳上狰爷的背，心情愉快地向第五街进发。

阿城：你是不是把你的任务对象我给忘了？

“你发什么呆，还不快点上来。不想回家了吗？”商非凡回头招呼。

阿城：“……来了。”
chunks.englishText:
A-Cheng: "Alright, I'm in no rush anyway. We're already at my doorstep."

Tiger the Handsome looked at the corpse of his giant insect companion and shook his head. "I still have a lot of things to deal with on my end. You have your own matters to attend to as well, right?"

Shang Feifan desperately wanted to stay by Tiger the Handsome's side, but... he turned and glanced at A-Cheng.

With this guy around, it was indeed inconvenient for him and Bu Shuai to talk about many things. It looked like he'd better get rid of this third wheel first.

A-Cheng felt like he was being shunned, and moreover, he had the evidence to prove it.

"Where are you staying right now? Once I'm done with my business, I'll come look for you. I still need to head back to Moyue Town, so we can just travel back together," Shang Feifan said quite casually.

He wasn't thinking about wooing Tiger the Handsome just yet, but he really did want to spend a little more time with this NPC, so he decided to follow his heart.

Tiger the Handsome wanted to say that he wouldn't be returning to Moyue Town anytime soon, but seeing A-Cheng standing off to the side, he swallowed those words back and changed his tune instead: "We have quite a few people with us, plus some cargo, so we rented a courtyard on the Ninth Street. The house number is..."

Shang Feifan memorized the address and made plans with Tiger the Handsome to meet up in the evening.

Before leaving, Shang Feifan suddenly turned around and gave Tiger the Handsome a quick embrace.

Caught entirely off guard, Tiger the Handsome was hugged before he could even struggle, and the embrace was broken just as quickly. For a moment, he didn't know what kind of expression to make when facing this overly enthusiastic tiger beastman.

A-Dai was squished right between the two of them, his square little face squeezed completely flat.

Tiger the Handsome's gaze collided with A-Dai's, and they saw a mutual speechlessness regarding a certain adult in each other's eyes.

Shang Feifan gave Tiger the Handsome a wave, scooped up A-Dai, and hopped onto the back of the Ferocious Beast, heading in high spirits toward the Fifth Street.

A-Cheng: *Did you forget that your quest target is me?*

"What are you daydreaming for? Hurry up and get on. Don't you want to go home?" Shang Feifan called back over his shoulder.

A-Cheng: "...Coming."

chunks.chineseText:
第40章 阿城的秘密

第五街嗡家附近邻居看到了让他们惊讶的一幕。

嗡家两年前离家出走的儿子嗡城回来了。

不但穿得人模狗样，他的同伴还带着一个幼崽。

如果不是他的同伴是一名身材高大的雄性兽人，这妥妥的带着媳妇和儿子回家的戏码。

“如果真是这样，老嗡夫妇俩能高兴死。”

“是啊，两年了，阿城应该已经放下了吧？”

“现在想想，那事真怪不了阿城，年轻人哪能受得了那种刺激，换了我，我也会热血上头。”

“你当时可不是这么说的，你说他蠢到家了，竟然会为一个交际女郎和男爵的儿子对上。要不是老嗡的老师还有点面子，阿城就算主动离开摩罗城，老嗡一家也无法继续安心过日子。”

“那可是彘庞男爵的小儿子！就算那不是他最心爱的长子，也不是普通人能招惹的。阿城当年要不是蠢，怎么可能明知彘献的身份，还要跟他争女人？”

“行了，那女人已经死了，彘献也已经去了王城，嗡城好不容易才回来，哪怕看在老嗡的面子上，这事最好也别提了。”

“知道知道，我这不就是跟你说说嘛。”

就在邻居一家说小话的时候，商非凡抱着阿呆正坐在嗡家的客厅里，被家主嗡东亭招待。

阿城则正在安慰他哭泣的母亲。

嗡家没有专门给坐骑准备的院落，狰爷只能趴在嗡家屋顶上。

嗡东亭不算是个太热情的人，看到离家两年才回来的儿子，神情虽有激动，却还能保持冷静。嗡母则完全相反，抱着儿子痛哭不已。

在短暂的尴尬时间后，阿城也没有跟父母隐瞒他这两年的倒霉经历。

听说儿子离开摩罗城不久，就被人偷光钱财，只能给路过的商队打零工。可不久又跟着商队一起被强盗抢劫，那支商队的护卫很强，带着绝大多数的货物和商队雇工逃出了强盗的包围圈。

但他们儿子却被臭雾果迷倒，被强盗抓回，又因为没什么技艺卖不出好价格，被强盗留在强盗窝里当奴隶，过了两年狗都不如的凄苦日子。

嗡母听得又止不住眼泪，抱着儿子心疼万分。

阿城最后说：“如果不是霍希尔先生救我出来，又一路护送我回来，我可能……”

阿城也抹了抹眼泪。

嗡母感激地看向商非凡。

嗡东亭也再次向商非凡道谢，不过这次就不只是客套，而是充满了感恩。

“人我已经送到，约定完成。我也该走了。”商非凡一副做好事不求回报的磊落模样，抱起阿呆，就打算告辞离开。

“等等！”嗡东亭哪可能让儿子的救命恩人就这么离开，再三挽留。

嗡母也连声邀请商非凡留下吃饭。

嗡东亭快速说：“阿城说您接了任务？我确实在黑市里发布了寻找阿城的任务，因为某些原因，我不能对外公开我要找回我儿子。我知道黑市那边两头收钱，还收得很狠。您不用特意去黑市找人交任务，我这边就能把任务报酬付给您，这样您也不用被黑市那边多刮一层。”

嗡东亭又道：“您也不用担心我。我好歹也是一名高级炼药学徒，和黑市那边还算有点关系，他们不敢敲诈我，我只要去打声招呼，把任务完成的手续费支付掉就可以。”

压根就没有在黑市领取任务的商非凡一听还有这个好处，也不客气了。

阿城也一直以为他是领取了任务才会来救他。

他这会儿要是拒绝任务报酬，那才让人心里犯嘀咕。

阿城还跟父母说：“我当时被那狠毒的大厨快要打死了，是霍希尔先生拿出了救命药。一路上他也对我多有照顾，不但保我性命，还供我吃喝，我身上的衣服和行头都是他给我准备的，最重要的是他还教授我真正的生活技能，教了我好些美食配方，以后我能开店养活自己。”

阿城红着眼睛看商非凡，他是真感激老商。

嗡东亭一听这话，当即就决定报酬要再厚上一倍。

把儿子带回来，和把儿子好端端还有面子地带回来，那可是两码事。更别说这位还教授他儿子实用的生活技能，更给出了好些配方，他给人当学徒的时候可是白白给人当小工当了五年。

而配方，只要不是烂大街的配方，哪个配方不要钱买？

嗡东亭暂时离开客厅，回来时带回一口小箱子。

嗡东亭把小箱子推到商非凡面前。

商非凡也没打开，单手提起小箱子：“那么，以后有缘再会。”

“如果您需要什么药剂，可以随时找我。不管您什么时候来，我们全家都欢迎您。”嗡东亭诚恳地说。除了报恩，他也是看商非凡气势不凡，存了结交之心。

商非凡心念一转，心想这现成的关系放着不用，岂不是浪费？

“治疗痢疾的药剂，还有伤药，您能弄到吗？”

“痢疾？是一般痢疾，还是疫病型？”嗡东亭反应很快，他可不认为商非凡这样的兽人会为了几支治疗普通痢疾的药剂特意询问他。

“疫病。我可能需要购买一批，量比较大，不需要成本价，只要是能给药商的批发价，并且希望药效质量更过关……”

“没问题！我可以马上帮你联系。伤药好说，治疗痢疾的药剂最好能给我详细的病情情况，痢疾类疫情也分不同种，如果能对症治疗，效果最好。”嗡东亭一听自己能帮上忙，立刻说道。

商非凡：“症状具体如何，我还需要问问我同伴。我明天再来拜访，不知是否方便？”

“方便方便！霍希尔先生您随时来。”

阿城看商非凡要走，再次喊住他：“霍希尔先生，您能跟我到我房间来一下吗，我有东西给您，算是我自个儿的一点心意。”

商非凡不喜欢这样拖拖拉拉，直接摇头。

阿城急了，“您等等！”

阿城竟然当场脱衣变身成小貂，然后伸爪子就在自己腹部划了一下。

鲜血流出，阿城用爪子在腹中掏摸。

嗡母焦急，嗡东亭皱眉，却没有阻止儿子自残的行为。

阿城发出一声痛呼，小爪子掏出什么东西。

嗡东亭迅速上前抱起儿子放到桌子上，嗡母已经飞快拿来药箱。

阿城用嘴巴叼着他从肚子中掏出来的东西，示意商非凡用手来接。

商非凡：“……”

嗡东亭在心中叹息，边给儿子疗伤，边对商非凡说：“这是这小子的心意，您就收下吧。”

商非凡手没动，问：“这是什么？”

嗡东亭其实也不太清楚，他只比别人多知道一点，那就是他儿子两年前会离开摩罗城，并不完全是因为得罪了彘庞男爵的小儿子，而是因为他得到了一样东西。

阿城看腹部伤口的血止住，再次变回人形，披上他母亲拿给他的毯子，吐出含在口中的物品，放在手上亮给商非凡看。

“这是内莉给我的。内莉是个好女孩，只是她运气不太好……”

阿城把当年他离家的原因和始末说了出来。

他爸妈也是第一次听到完整版。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 40: A-Cheng's Secret

The neighbors near the Weng residence on the Fifth Street witnessed a scene that left them astonished.

Weng Cheng, the Weng family's son who had run away from home two years ago, was back.

Not only was he dressed to the nines and looking proper, but his companion also brought along a child.

If not for the fact that his companion was a tall, strapping male beastman, this would have been the textbook definition of bringing a wife and son back home to visit.

"If that were really the case, the old Weng couple would probably die of joy."

"Yeah, it's been two years. A-Cheng should have let it go by now, right?"

"Now that I think about it, you really can't blame A-Cheng for that incident. What young man could endure that kind of provocation? If it were me, my blood would have boiled over too."

"You certainly weren't saying that back then. You said he was a complete fool to go up against a courtesan and a baron's son. If old Weng's teacher hadn't still carried a bit of weight, even if A-Cheng had voluntarily left Moluo City, the Weng family wouldn't have been able to live in peace."

"That was Baron Zhipang's youngest son! Even if he wasn't his most beloved eldest son, he wasn't someone an ordinary person could afford to provoke. If A-Cheng hadn't been an idiot back then, how could he have known Zhi Xian's identity and still fought him over a woman?"

"Alright, that woman is already dead, and Zhi Xian has already gone to the Royal City. Weng Cheng has finally managed to come back; out of respect for old Weng, it's best not to bring this up anymore."

"I know, I know. I was just chatting with you, that's all."

While the neighbors were gossiping amongst themselves, Shang Feifan was holding A-Dai as they sat in the Weng family's living room, being hosted by the head of the household, Weng Dongting.

A-Cheng, meanwhile, was comforting his weeping mother.

The Weng family didn't have a courtyard specifically prepared for mounts, so Ferocious could only lie down on the Weng family's roof.

Weng Dongting wasn't a particularly effusive person. Upon seeing the son who had returned home after a two-year absence, though his expression carried a hint of emotional turmoil, he managed to maintain his composure. Madame Weng was the complete opposite, holding her son and weeping bitterly.

After a brief period of awkwardness, A-Cheng didn't hide his miserable experiences over the past two years from his parents.

He recounted how, shortly after leaving Moluo City, he had all his money stolen and was forced to pick up odd jobs for passing caravans. Soon after, however, the caravan he was traveling with was attacked and plundered by bandits. The caravan's guards were formidable and managed to escape the bandits' encirclement with the vast majority of the goods and hired hands.

Their son, however, had been knocked out by Stinky Fog Fruit powder and captured by the bandits. Because he lacked any particular skills and couldn't fetch a good price, the bandits kept him in their den as a slave, where he spent two miserable years living a life worse than a dog's.

Hearing this, Madame Weng couldn't stop her tears, hugging her son and feeling heartbroken beyond measure.

A-Cheng finally said, "If Mr. Hoshier hadn't rescued me and escorted me all the way back, I might have..."

A-Cheng wiped away his own tears as well.

Madame Weng looked at Shang Feifan with deep gratitude.

Weng Dongting also thanked Shang Feifan once again, though this time it wasn't mere polite formality, but filled with genuine gratefulness.

"I've delivered the person, and our agreement is fulfilled. I should be leaving now." Shang Feifan put on the upright, righteous demeanor of someone doing a good deed without seeking reward, picked up A-Dai, and prepared to bid his farewells.

"Wait!" How could Weng Dongting let his son's savior leave just like that? He offered repeated and earnest entreaties for him to stay.

Madame Weng also chimed in, cordially inviting Shang Feifan to stay for a meal.

Weng Dongting quickly spoke up: "A-Cheng said you accepted a commission? I did indeed post a commission in the black market to search for A-Cheng. For certain reasons, I couldn't make the search for my son public. I know the black market takes a cut from both ends, and they take a vicious slice at that. You don't need to make a special trip to the black market to hand in the quest; I can pay you the bounty right here. That way, you won't have to let the black market skin another layer off you."

Weng Dongting added, "You don't need to worry about me either. I am, after all, a senior apothecary apprentice, and I still have some connections with the black market. They wouldn't dare shake me down. I just need to go over, say a word, and pay the administrative fee for completing the commission."

Shang Feifan, who hadn't even picked up a commission in the black market in the first place, heard about this unexpected perk and gracefully dropped his polite refusals.

A-Cheng had all along assumed that he had only come to rescue him because he had accepted the commission.

If he were to refuse the quest reward at this point, it would only make people suspicious.

A-Cheng even told his parents: "I was practically beaten to death by that vicious head chef back then, and it was Mr. Hoshier who produced life-saving medicine. Along the way, he took great care of me, not only protecting my life but also supplying me with food and drink. The clothes and outfit I'm wearing were all prepared for me by him. Most importantly, he even taught me genuine practical life skills and gave me quite a few culinary recipes so that I can open a shop and support myself in the future."

A-Cheng looked at Shang Feifan with reddened eyes; he was truly grateful to Old Shang.

Upon hearing this, Weng Dongting immediately decided to double the bounty.

Bringing a son back, and bringing a son back safe, sound, and with his dignity intact—those were two completely different matters. Not to mention that this person had taught his son practical life skills and provided numerous recipes; when his son had worked as an apprentice for others, he had spent five solid years doing menial labor for free.

And recipes—as long as they weren't utterly worthless street-tier formulas—which recipe didn't cost a fortune to buy?

Weng Dongting temporarily left the living room, returning a moment later carrying a small wooden box.

He pushed the small box across the table toward Shang Feifan.

Without even opening it, Shang Feifan picked up the small box with one hand and said, "Then, until we meet again by fate."

"If you ever need any potions, feel free to look for me. No matter when you come, our entire family will welcome you," Weng Dongting said sincerely. Aside from repaying a debt of gratitude, he also saw that Shang Feifan possessed an extraordinary aura and harbored thoughts of striking up a lasting friendship.

A thought flashed through Shang Feifan's mind. He figured that leaving a ready-made connection like this unused would simply be a waste.

"Dysentery potions, as well as healing medicines—can you get your hands on those?"

"Dysentery? Is it ordinary dysentery or epidemic-type?" Weng Dongting reacted very quickly. He didn't believe that a beastman like Shang Feifan would go out of his way to inquire about a few ordinary dysentery potions.

"Epidemic. I may need to purchase a batch, and the quantity is quite large. I don't need cost price—wholesale price for pharmaceutical merchants is fine, provided the medicinal efficacy and quality are more reliable..."

"No problem! I can contact someone for you right away. Healing medicine is easy, but for dysentery potions, it would be best to give me the detailed symptoms. Epidemic dysentery comes in different strains; targeting it specifically yields the best results." Upon hearing that he could be of help, Weng Dongting immediately spoke up.

Shang Feifan: "As for the specific symptoms, I still need to ask my companion. I'll come by to visit again tomorrow; I hope that won't be an inconvenience?"

"Not at all, not at all! Mr. Hoshier, you are welcome to come whenever you like."

Seeing that Shang Feifan was about to leave, A-Cheng called out to him once more: "Mr. Hoshier, could you come to my room for a moment? I have something for you—consider it a little token of my own appreciation."

Shang Feifan disliked lingering and dragging things out, so he shook his head directly.

A-Cheng grew anxious. "Please, wait!"

To everyone's shock, A-Cheng transformed into a small marten right on the spot, then reached out with his claws and slashed right across his own belly.

Fresh blood poured out as A-Cheng dug his claws into his abdomen, groping around inside.

Madame Weng panicked, and Weng Dongting frowned, yet neither stopped their son's act of self-mutilation.

A-Cheng let out a painful groan as his small claws fished something out.

Weng Dongting quickly stepped forward, picked up his son, and placed him on the table, while Madame Weng had already rushed over with a medical kit in hand.

Clenching an object in his jaws that he had pulled from his stomach, A-Cheng signaled for Shang Feifan to catch it with his hand.

Shang Feifan: "..."

Weng Dongting sighed inwardly. As he tended to his son's wound, he said to Shang Feifan, "This is the kid's heartfelt intention; please accept it."

Shang Feifan kept his hands still and asked, "What is this?"

In truth, Weng Dongting didn't quite know either. He only knew a little more than others—namely, that the reason his son had left Moluo City two years ago wasn't entirely because he had offended Baron Zhipang's youngest son, but rather because he had obtained an item.

Seeing that the bleeding from his abdominal wound had stopped, A-Cheng transformed back into human form, draped a blanket his mother handed him over his shoulders, spat out the item he had been holding in his mouth, and held it out in his palm to show Shang Feifan.

"Nelly gave this to me. Nelly was a good girl, it's just that her luck wasn't very good..."

A-Cheng recounted the cause, beginning, and end of why he had left home back then.

It was also the first time his parents were hearing the complete version.

chunks.chineseText:
简单说就是当年还是一个单纯青年的嗡城在酒馆买醉消愁时遇到了一朵美丽的解语花。

作为药师的儿子，嗡城却丝毫没有炼药的天赋，他连药草名字都记不全，也不喜欢炼药。他觉得周围认识的人都在嘲笑他，觉得父亲耽误了他，认为自己如果能学习别的职业技能，也许就能出人头地，可他又不知道自己擅长什么，结果就这么浑浑噩噩的度日。

解语花安慰他、鼓励他，涉世未深的嗡城很快就陷入美人的温柔怀抱。

但那时的嗡城还不知道他只是解语花精心挑选出来的挡箭牌之一。

几个挡箭牌就他把解语花当成了真女友，想要和人家好好发展下去，还想要结婚。

然后他就招惹来了解语花的姘头，彘庞男爵的小儿子彘献。

本来这应该是一桩非常常见的争风吃醋的风流事件，但谁想那解语花竟然另有身份，彘献看中这朵解语花也不仅仅是因为她的美貌，而是为了她母亲留给她的一件物品。

“内莉的母亲曾是一名古老兽人村的祭司，我不知道她母亲为什么会离开那个古老村落，内莉没跟我说。她只告诉我，她母亲把她抚养到十三岁左右就去世了，死前给了她这个东西，让她藏在自己身体内。”

“她母亲是祭司的事，她没有告诉任何人。她母亲留给她的钱财也足以让她长大，但她一个小女孩想要保住她母亲留给她的财产并不容易，她又识人不明，在十四岁时喜欢上一个渣子，被对方骗色骗财，还被对方威胁着成为交际女郎，又被对方介绍给彘献，让她被彘献纠缠上。”

嗡母听到儿子说到这里时，眼中闪过一丝愤怒，忍不住插话：“那个女人在骗你！也就你才会相信她编造的谎言。”

“我早就打听过，她有个未婚夫，是她母亲生前为她定下。她未婚夫一家也对她很好，就准备在她成年后和她完婚。可她向往贵族的生活，千方百计勾搭上彘庞男爵的儿子。据说她本来想勾搭的是人家长子，但人家根本看不上她，她就转而勾搭了彘庞男爵的小儿子彘献！”

“但她没想到彘献把她当交际女郎看，也就是拿她玩玩，她不忿，想要让彘献吃醋，才会找其他男人鬼混。也就是你那么傻，竟然被她骗得团团转……”

“好了。他已经受教训了。”嗡东亭按住妻子的手，让她别再说下去。

嗡母难受。

阿城低着头，也不知是不想反驳母亲，还是在心里腹诽。

嗡东亭一脸不想家丑外扬的尴尬神情看向商非凡。

商非凡：“我的记性不太好，很多事情听完就会忘。”

嗡东亭叹息，看了看儿子：“他离家后，我就找人详细调查过这件事，至少我得弄清楚那个女人的死和我儿子有没有关系，以及彘庞男爵为什么会在阿城打伤他小儿子还能那么大度地放我儿子离开。但我现在知道他并没有放过我儿子。”

阿城猛地抬起头，满眼不可置信。随后又像是明白了什么，颓然地垂下头。

嗡母抹泪。

商非凡：“这么说阿城会被人偷光钱财，乃至被强盗抓去当奴隶，就是那位男爵的报复？”

嗡东亭沉默了一会儿：“否则无法解释那支商队为什么能顺利从臭雾果的昏迷效果下全部逃脱，最后只留下我儿子一个人被强盗抓走。而且强盗还没有杀他，也没有卖掉他，只把他当奴隶一样折磨。”

阿城身体发抖。

嗡母心疼地搂住儿子身体。

商非凡略头疼，“那阿城现在回来，那个男爵还会再找他麻烦吗？”

嗡东亭摇摇头，“彘庞男爵已经为他小儿子出手一次，就不会再出手第二次。何况……我的面子也许不算什么，但我老师在本城还算有些地位。彘庞男爵两年前没有明着报复，就是顾忌我的老师。但是，”

“但是把阿城带回来的我，说不定现在已经上了那位男爵的黑名单，对吗？”商非凡了然。

嗡东亭眼中满是歉意：“他应该不会马上对您做什么。只要您之后不会和他对上。”

“明白。我现在在那位男爵眼中还只是个小人物。”商非凡无所谓地笑笑。

嗡家一家三口对商非凡更加感到歉疚。

阿城显然也没想到他的倒霉经历背后还牵扯到这么多，他喏喏地想要道歉，被商非凡抬手止住。

“继续你刚才没说完的故事。这一小节黑漆漆的圆柱到底是什么？有什么作用？那个男爵小儿子为什么要得到它？”商非凡问。

嗡东亭先一步开口：“我先补充几点我调查到的、而我儿子不知道的事情。第一点，那个女人，内莉她怀孕了。在和我儿子交往的时候就已经怀有身孕。”

阿城脸黑得非常彻底，他根本不知道这件事。

嗡东亭继续：“第二件事，内莉想要凭借肚子里的孩子嫁给彘献，她很可能为了加大自己的筹码，跟彘献说了自己母亲的祭司身份。妄图以她身上有祭司血脉，她生的孩子很可能觉醒神血天赋这一点，让男爵同意她嫁入男爵府。”

“但彘献显然不是在乎这点的人，他也绝不可能找一个平民甚至背负交际女之名的女人结婚。原本他想尽快甩掉内莉这个包袱，甚至想要找人弄掉她肚子里的孩子。没想到内莉自己犯蠢，也不知道听了谁的指点，担心彘献不肯娶她，她就得未婚生育，就想再找个接盘的人。”

“对于内莉的犯蠢，彘献显然乐见其成。这也是我儿子和内莉刚认识那段时间，没有任何人提醒他、阻碍他的缘故。”

阿城……捂住了自己的脸。

嗡东亭没有看儿子：“但是后面情况发生了一些变化。这很可能跟彘献找人调查了内莉母亲的身份有关。他可能没有特意调查，但他身边的人知道了内莉母亲的祭司身份，为了巴结彘献，就跑去调查此事。”

“我不知道他们查到了什么，但彘献突然对内莉改变态度，要内莉跟他回男爵府，还谎称要娶她。可内莉那时……”

嗡东亭神情复杂：“我儿子虽然蠢了点，但他当时是真的爱上了内莉，而我们家条件也不算差。内莉当时应该也是对我儿子动心了，毕竟谁不想被人宠爱？”

“内莉应该是拒绝了彘献，并明确跟他说出他们之间已经结束，让彘献不要再来找她。为此，内莉还去找秘医，想要用药物打掉腹中胎儿。”

阿城眼中流出了眼泪。

嗡东亭忍住没有去看儿子：“内莉打掉胎儿的同时，也因为大出血去世。我不知道这件事有没有彘庞男爵的手笔，我也无法调查到这种程度。阿城以为内莉的死与逼迫她的彘献有关，跑去和彘献决斗。”

“阿城背着我花了大价钱买了一个炼金武器，彘献好面子，接受了阿城的挑战。最后彘献被打伤。作为男爵的小儿子，心高气傲的彘献自然咽不下这口气，就开始处处针对我儿子，不断找人打他、侮辱他。同时我这边也受到了一些影响。”
chunks.englishText:
CHINESE SOURCE TEXT (第40章 阿城的秘密 (Part 2)):
To put it simply, Weng Cheng, who was still a naive young man back then, was drowning his sorrows with alcohol in a tavern when he met a beautiful confidante.

As the son of an apothecary, Weng Cheng possessed zero talent for alchemy; he couldn't even memorize the names of medicinal herbs, nor did he enjoy alchemy. He felt that the people around him were all mocking him, that his father was holding him back, and that if he could just learn other professional skills, he might finally make something of himself. Yet he had no idea what he was good at, and as a result, he drifted through his days in a daze.

The confidante comforted and encouraged him, and the inexperienced Weng Cheng quickly fell into the beauty's tender embrace.

Little did Weng Cheng know back then that he was merely one of the meticulously chosen smoke screens for that confidante.

Out of all the smoke screens, he was the only one who mistook the confidante for a genuine girlfriend, hoping to build a serious future with her and even get married.

And then, he drew the ire of the confidante's sugar daddy—Zhi Xian, the youngest son of Baron Zhipang.

Ordinarily, this should have been a very common romantic affair born of jealousy and rivalry. But who would have thought that the confidante had a hidden background? Zhi Xian had set his sights on this confidante not merely for her beauty, but for an item her mother had left behind.

"Nelly's mother was once a priestess of an ancient beastman tribe. I don't know why her mother left that ancient village; Nelly didn't tell me. She only told me that her mother raised her until she was around thirteen before passing away, and right before she died, she gave her this item and told her to hide it inside her body."

"She didn't tell anyone that her mother was a priestess. The money left behind by her mother was enough for her to grow up on, but for a young girl, holding onto her mother's inheritance was no easy task. Moreover, she was poor at judging people; at fourteen, she fell for a scumbag who cheated her out of both her virtue and her money. He then threatened her into becoming a courtesan, and subsequently introduced her to Zhi Xian, causing Zhi Xian to pester her."

When Mother Weng heard her son reach this point, a flash of anger crossed her eyes, and she couldn't help but interrupt: "That woman was lying to you! You're the only one who would believe the fabrications she made up."

"I made inquiries long ago: she had a fiance chosen for her by her mother before she passed away. Her fiance's family treated her very well, and they were planning to marry her off once she came of age. But she yearned for a noble lifestyle and went out of her way to seduce Baron Zhipang's son. Rumor has it that she originally wanted to hook the eldest son, but he wouldn't give her the time of day, so she turned around and seduced Baron Zhipang's youngest son, Zhi Xian instead!"

"Yet she never expected that Zhi Xian treated her like a mere courtesan—someone to play with and cast aside. Unreconciled and wanting to make Zhi Xian jealous, she went messing around with other men. You were the only fool who let her twist you around her finger..."

"Enough. He's already learned his lesson." Weng Dongting pressed down on his wife's hand, signaling her to stop talking.

Mother Weng felt deeply distressed.

A-Cheng kept his head lowered, unsure whether he didn't want to talk back to his mother or was grumbling in his heart.

With an expression of awkwardness that showed he loathed washing dirty linen in public, Weng Dongting looked toward Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan: "My memory isn't very good. I tend to forget a lot of things once I've heard them."

Weng Dongting sighed and glanced at his son. "After he left home, I had people thoroughly investigate this matter—at least I needed to figure out whether that woman's death had anything to do with my son, and why Baron Zhipang could be magnanimous enough to let my son go after A-Cheng beat up his youngest son. But now I know he never let my son go at all."

A-Cheng abruptly raised his head, his eyes filled with disbelief. Then, as if he had realized something, his shoulders slumped in defeat.

Mother Weng wiped away her tears.

Shang Feifan: "Are you saying that A-Cheng having all his money stolen and even being captured as a slave by bandits was all retaliation from that baron?"

Weng Dongting was silent for a moment. "Otherwise, there's no way to explain why that caravan managed to completely escape the anesthetic effects of the Stinky Fog Fruit, leaving only my son behind to be captured by the bandits. Furthermore, the bandits didn't kill him, nor did they sell him; they just tortured him like a slave."

A-Cheng's body trembled.

Mother Weng clutched her son's body with heartbreak.

Shang Feifan felt a mild headache coming on. "Now that A-Cheng is back, will that baron come looking for trouble with him again?"

Weng Dongting shook his head. "Since Baron Zhipang has already made a move for his youngest son once, he won't make a second move. Besides... my standing might not amount to much, but my mentor still holds some status in this city. The reason Baron Zhipang didn't retaliate openly two years ago was precisely out of regard for my mentor. However—"

"However, by bringing A-Cheng back, I might have just landed on that baron's black list, am I right?" Shang Feifan understood instantly.

Weng Dongting's eyes were filled with apology. "He probably won't do anything to you right away. As long as you don't cross paths with him in the future."

"Understood. In that baron's eyes, I'm still just a small fry for now." Shang Feifan smiled indifferently.

The three members of the Weng family felt an even deeper sense of guilt toward Shang Feifan.

A-Cheng clearly hadn't expected so many entanglements to lie behind his wretched experiences. He stammered, wanting to apologize, but was stopped by a wave of Shang Feifan's hand.

"Continue with the story you hadn't finished. What on earth is this pitch-black cylinder? What does it do? Why did the baron's youngest son want to get his hands on it?" Shang Feifan asked.

Weng Dongting spoke up first. "Let me add a few points that I found out through my investigation, which my son didn't know. First, that woman—Nelly was pregnant. She was already pregnant while she was seeing my son."

A-Cheng's face turned completely dark; he had known nothing about this.

Weng Dongting continued: "Second, Nelly wanted to use the child in her belly to marry into Zhi Xian's family. To up her stakes, she most likely told Zhi Xian about her mother's identity as a priestess. She harbored the delusion that possessing priestess bloodline and the possibility that her child might awaken divine blood talent would persuade the baron to let her marry into the baron's estate."

"But Zhi Xian clearly wasn't someone who cared about such things, nor would he ever marry a commoner, let alone a woman saddled with the reputation of a courtesan. Originally, he wanted to shake off Nelly as a burden as quickly as possible, and even wanted to find someone to get rid of the child in her belly. He never expected Nelly to be foolish enough—who knows whose bad advice she listened to—to worry that Zhi Xian wouldn't marry her and that she'd be left an unwed mother, prompting her to look for someone else to take the blame."

"Zhi Xian was obviously overjoyed at Nelly's stupidity. That's why, during the period when my son and Nelly first met, no one reminded him or stopped him."

A-Cheng... covered his face with his hands.

Weng Dongting didn't look at his son. "However, the situation changed later on. This was most likely related to Zhi Xian having someone investigate Nelly mother's identity. He might not have investigated it personally, but the people around him found out about Nelly mother's priestess background and went to investigate the matter to curry favor with Zhi Xian."

"I don't know what they dug up, but Zhi Xian suddenly changed his attitude toward Nelly, demanding that she return to the baron's estate with him and lying that he would marry her. But Nelly at that time—"

Weng Dongting's expression grew complex. "Although my son was a bit foolish, he was truly in love with Nelly back then, and our family's financial situation wasn't bad either. Nelly must have grown fond of my son at the time; after all, who doesn't want to be cherished?"

"Nelly must have refused Zhi Xian, making it clear to him that things between them were over and telling him not to come looking for her anymore. To that end, Nelly even went to see an underground doctor, wanting to use medicine to abort the child in her womb."

Tears streamed from A-Cheng's eyes.

Weng Dongting forced himself not to look at his son. "While Nelly was aborting the fetus, she also passed away from severe hemorrhaging. I don't know if Baron Zhipang had a hand in this matter; I couldn't investigate to that extent. A-Cheng, thinking that Nelly's death was tied to Zhi Xian pushing her into a corner, went off to challenge Zhi Xian to a duel."

"Behind my back, A-Cheng spent a huge sum of money to buy an alchemical weapon. Zhi Xian, valuing his pride, accepted A-Challenges challenge. In the end, Zhi Xian was beaten and injured. As the baron's youngest son, the proud and arrogant Zhi Xian naturally couldn't swallow that humiliation, and he began targeting my son at every turn, constantly sending people to beat and humiliate him. At the same time, my side was affected as well."

chunks.chineseText:
“那时我和我妻子因为各种频出的事情被搞得焦头烂额，也顾不得去查清楚背后都发生了什么事，加上外面难听的传言，知道阿城喜欢上了一个交际女郎，还为了这个女人和男爵小儿子对上，就埋怨阿城。”

“然后……阿城就离家出走了。”

嗡东亭说到这里，重重叹息：“我们等到他离家好几天后才发现他走了，我们就阿城一个孩子，自然后悔难过。我当时就让人去寻回阿城，也开始找关系调查阿城和男爵小儿子之间到底发生了什么事。期间，我老师帮了我很多忙。另外，我感觉还有一股力量也在引着我发现真相，我怀疑就是彘庞男爵。这是他的威慑，也是他的警告。”

“对不起！我不知道……都怪我！”阿城扑通在父母面前跪下，掩面哭泣。

很多事情他都不知道，就像他压根不知道他父母也受到了彘献的打击报复。

而他那时只顾着埋怨父母不理解自己、不帮着自己，觉得自己丢脸，只想逃出摩罗城。

嗡东亭只是揉了揉儿子的脑袋。他不怪自己的儿子，同样他也没有怨怼内莉，甚至也没有怨恨彘庞男爵和他的小儿子彘献。

不是他大度，而是他只能选择放开。

阿城哭了好一会儿，才断断续续地把他得到黑漆漆圆柱的事情补完。

原来内莉服下打胎药大出血后就让人喊来阿城，跟他交代后事。

阿城不知道内莉服下打胎药，还以为她是被彘献派人打伤，对彘献恨之入骨，等到内莉死后才会去找彘献决斗。

内莉死前，从自己身体中取出这枚三厘米长的黑漆漆圆柱体，并把自己的身世也告诉了阿城。

“我不知道这东西到底有什么用，内莉只跟我说这东西关系到祭司传承，以及有可能会帮助觉醒神血天赋。”

“但她并不知道这东西的具体使用方法，她把这东西藏在体内多年，也没有觉醒神血天赋。她只是把这东西当做念想留给了我。然后她还告诉我，彘献也想得到它，让我不要告诉任何人。”

阿城擦干眼泪：“我把这东西放入身体两年也没有觉醒神血天赋，大概这东西到底和我无缘。而且我也得承认，我不想让这东西再招惹来男爵一家，我现在就想和我父母好好过安生的日子。”

阿城再次伸出手，“如果您不要这东西，我就把它送到拍卖行，大张旗鼓地拍卖它。”

嗡东亭也非常支持儿子的做法，他对这有可能觉醒神血天赋的东西毫无贪婪之心，甚至同样把它视为大麻烦。

嗡母同样，他们一家现在只想远离一切危险。

原本，阿城对这东西是舍不得的，把它当做是爱人留给自己的纪念。可他觉得自己无法报答商非凡的恩情，想着这东西也许能帮助恩人觉醒神血天赋，才决定咬牙送出。

可现在知道内莉对他多是利用，而不是真的爱他以后，他再看这纪念物，就觉得当年的自己好傻好蠢。

主要还是两年的折磨生活，让浓烈的爱意变得越来越淡，每当他被强盗们折磨虐待时，他不知道自己有多少次后悔过……

他一直都觉得后悔（为爱情付出一切）的自己很耻辱。

现在知道真相，他就像是得到解脱一般，放松了。

她就没有真正爱过我，那我不再爱她，也很公平。
chunks.englishText:
"At the time, my wife and I were completely overwhelmed by one crisis after another. We didn't have the bandwidth to investigate what was happening behind the scenes, and coupled with the ugly rumors outside—hearing that A-Cheng had fallen for a courtesan and gone up against the baron's youngest son over her—we blamed A-Cheng."

"And then... A-Cheng ran away from home."

Reaching this point, Weng Dongting heaved a heavy sigh. "We didn't realize he was gone until several days after he fled. He's our only child, so of course we felt regret and grief. Right away, I sent people to track A-Cheng down and began using my connections to investigate what had really transpired between him and the baron's youngest son. During that time, my teacher helped me out immensely. Furthermore, I felt as though an invisible force was guiding me toward the truth; I suspect it was Baron Zhipang. It was a form of deterrence, and a warning."

"I'm sorry! I had no idea... It's all my fault!" A-Cheng dropped to his knees before his parents with a heavy thud, burying his face as he wept.

There was so much he hadn't known, just as he had been completely unaware that his parents had also suffered Zhi Xian's retaliation and suppression.

Yet back then, all he could do was resent his parents for not understanding him, for not backing him up, feeling utterly humiliated and wishing only to escape Moluo City.

Weng Dongting merely rubbed his son's head. He didn't blame his boy, nor did he harbor resentment toward Nelly, nor did he even hate Baron Zhipang or his youngest son, Zhi Xian.

It wasn't because he was magnanimous; rather, it was because he had no choice but to let it go.

After crying for quite a while, A-Cheng haltingly finished recounting how he had obtained the pitch-black cylinder.

As it turned out, after taking the abortion medicine and hemorrhaging heavily, Nelly had summoned A-Cheng to entrust him with her final words.

Unaware that Nelly had taken abortive medicine and believing instead that she had been beaten to death by Zhi Xian's hirelings, A-Cheng harbored a bone-deep hatred for Zhi Xian, which was why he went to challenge him to a duel after Nelly died.

Before her death, Nelly had extracted this three-centimeter-long pitch-black cylinder from her own body and revealed her background to A-Cheng.

"I have no idea what this thing is actually for. Nelly only told me that it's tied to the priestess inheritance and might possibly help awaken divine blood talent."

"But she didn't know how to use it either. She kept it hidden in her body for years without ever awakening any divine blood talent. She simply left it to me as a keepsake. She also told me that Zhi Xian wanted to get his hands on it too, and warned me never to tell anyone."

A-Cheng wiped away his tears. "I kept this thing inside my body for two years without awakening any divine blood talent; clearly, it wasn't meant for me. Besides, I have to admit—I don't want this thing to attract the baron's family ever again. Right now, I just want to live a peaceful life with my parents."

A-Cheng extended his hand once more. "If you don't want this thing, I'll take it to the auction house and auction it off in a grand, high-profile way."

Weng Dongting strongly supported his son's approach. He held no greed whatsoever for an item that might awaken divine blood talent; in fact, he viewed it purely as a massive trouble-maker.

Madame Weng felt the same way. Their family now just wanted to steer clear of all danger.

Originally, A-Cheng had been reluctant to part with the item, treating it as a memento left behind by his lover. But feeling that he could never adequately repay Shang Feifan's kindness—and figuring that perhaps this item could help his benefactor awaken divine blood talent—he had steeled his heart to give it away.

Yet now, knowing that Nelly had mostly used him rather than truly loving him, looking at this keepsake only made him realize how foolish and idiotic his past self had been.

Primarily, two years of torment and brutal living had caused those intense romantic feelings to fade away until almost nothing was left. Every time he was tortured and abused by the bandits, he lost count of how many times he had regretted it...

He had always felt deeply ashamed of himself for regretting it (having given his all for love).

Now that he knew the truth, it was as though he had finally attained release, feeling a sense of profound relief.

*She never truly loved me to begin with, so if I stop loving her, it's only fair.*

chunks.chineseText:
第41章 虫母的心脏

商非凡并不心动，还有点嫌弃：“你们可以把它拍卖掉，那位男爵如果想要这东西，自然会花钱买下，也算是弥补你们家的损失。同时也能为你们解除后顾之忧。”

嗡东亭摇摇头，从儿子手中接过那枚黑漆漆圆柱体，手指指甲一弹，突然在自己手掌心划了一下。

鲜血流出。

嗡东亭把那圆柱体往自己手掌心按了按。

阿城和嗡母全都惊讶地看向他。

等了一会儿，嗡东亭对商非凡说道：“您看，这东西对我也没有任何反应。”

嗡东亭又把圆柱体塞给嗡母，让她也尝试一下。

嗡母看看丈夫，也划破手掌照做一遍，但那枚圆柱体仍旧毫无反应。

嗡东亭取过圆柱体再次递送到商非凡面前，十分诚实地说：“我们一家都尝试过了，这东西显然和我们家无缘，送给您，我们也不会后悔。如果按照您所说，我们把这东西拍卖，或拿去送给男爵，我们也没办法证明这就是内莉送给我儿子的东西，那位男爵也不会相信。除非他和他儿子们能对这东西有反应，但如果真这样，我可能会气死。”

商非凡嘴角微弯。他能理解嗡家人的心情。那就是自己得不到，也绝对不想便宜仇人。

嗡东亭又道：“之前我不知道有这么一个东西在，以为那位找人偷走我儿子所有行李，以及让他在强盗窝当奴隶，只是为了折磨他，但现在……折磨恐怕只是他的目的之一。我想那位可能也是在寻找这个东西，故意把阿城囚禁在强盗窝也是为了观察他是否觉醒神血天赋。”

“那位应该也在我们家翻找过，没找到。我儿子又从来没有跟别人说过此事，所以那位可能只是有所怀疑，并不确定内莉是否真的把东西给了阿城。内莉死后，阿城把她埋在了城北公共墓地，但如果我所料不错，内莉的尸体恐怕已经不在坟墓中。”

阿城嘴唇抖了抖，他还是对内莉有感情，听说她死后都不得安生，心里就忍不住生出一股怒意和强烈郁闷。

为什么他只是一个小人物呢，为什么他无法拥有强大的力量，让他想要保护家人、保护所爱的人都做不到！

嗡东亭拍拍儿子，直接把那枚圆柱体放到商非凡面前的桌子上。

“所以我们现在如果把这东西送去拍卖也好，拿去献给那位也好，反而会暴露阿城确实从内莉那里得到这东西的秘密。如果男爵拿着这东西却发现毫无作用，以他的多疑，只会怀疑我们家藏起真货，拿了个假货糊弄他。这反而会让他盯上我们一家，甚至不惜得罪我老师也要找我们一家麻烦，直到他得到他想要得到的。”

嗡东亭看着商非凡的眼睛，异常诚恳，甚至带着一点乞求道：“您拿走它，反而是帮了我们一家。”

商非凡在心中叹了口气。

嗡家人都说到这种程度，这东西他也只能带走了。

嗡东亭甚至为了不让自家后悔，让家人都试了一遍。

商非凡伸手，从桌子上拿起那枚黑漆漆的圆柱体。

“那就这样。如果那位男爵来找你们麻烦，找你们索要这东西，你们可以告诉他，是我拿走了。”

反正他只是一个玩家，麻烦也就相当于任务。换了其他玩家，巴不得有这么一个麻烦找上门呢。

嗡东亭感激又愧疚，张了张口，只能说：“以后您在药剂方面有什么需求，只管来找我。只要我能帮上忙，我一定竭尽全力。”

商非凡也没仔细打量那圆柱体，只是握着那东西站起身：“我明天再来拜访。”

“好好好。”嗡家人也再次起身相送。

快要走到门口，商非凡突然转头，对着阿城说：“记住，只有我，来自黑森林城的诺曼霍希尔，和其他人毫无关系。”

阿城先没反应过来，后陡然想起商非凡在药剂市场遇到的那人。他懂了，这是让他不要把那人牵扯进来。

阿城重重点头，表示知道。

嗡东亭越过商非凡，手握住了门把手。

就在这刹那间，嗡母和阿城同时发出惊呼。

嗡东亭转头，就看到他们家的那位恩人在转眼间被一层黑漆漆宛如油漆膜一样的东西以不算太慢的速度包裹住。

阿呆被油膜绕开，小家伙焦急地叫爸爸。

阿城立刻伸手，让他赶紧过来。

商非凡也看到了身上变化，他看得很清楚，这层黑漆漆的膜就是从他的手心里蔓延出来。

这是想让他COS毒液吗？

商非凡刚这样想到，脑中就想起了叮咚声。

【奇遇任务！你在偶然间得到了虫母九分之一的心脏，这是你的幸运还是不幸，全看你的选择。虫母的能量正在侵袭你全身，你只有三分钟时间可以考虑并做出选择。选择有三：

1，选择融合，让虫母的九分之一心脏改造你的血脉，让你向真正的虫族进化。虫族能力多样，首先你将获得类似小强的顽强生命力，俗称打不死。当然，并不是真正的打不死。以后会有什么变化，未知。也有一定几率改造失败。

2，选择吸收虫母九分之一心脏，让其助你已经觉醒的血脉天赋升级。能升多少级，能给哪个血脉天赋升级，未知。也有一定几率升级失败。

3，选择转化虫母九分之一心脏的能量，让其助你觉醒新的血脉天赋。可以觉醒的血脉天赋未知。也有一定几率觉醒失败。

注意！如果在三分钟内无法做出选择，系统将摧毁这个奇遇。倒计时开始……】

商非凡：“……”

在略作思考后，他选择吸收这份虫母心脏，助他已经觉醒的血脉天赋升级。

选择一会让他变成虫族。可只看兽人们对虫族的排斥心，就知道这个选择会让他站在兽人的对立面。他还想和这里的土著NPC交朋友，当然不想让对方排斥自己。

不过如果就喜欢和主流对着来，喜欢做反派的玩家，应该会比较心悦这个选择。

对于现实主流世界就是反派的商非凡其实对选择一很是心动。

选择三可以让人有期待感，但谁也不知道会觉醒什么样的血脉天赋，从概率上来说，觉醒失败和觉醒出没什么用处和奇葩天赋的可能性更高。

商非凡理智地看了看自己的幸运值，毫不犹豫地选择了对自己最有利的选项。

在商非凡做出选择的瞬间，那层黑漆漆的油膜迅速包裹住商非凡全身。

嗡家人全都紧张地看着站在那里不动的商非凡。

阿呆不肯离开老商，依旧窝在老商怀里。

“小家伙你过来，你爸爸也许在觉醒血脉天赋，你最好不要打扰他。”

阿呆听嗡东亭这样说，才犹犹豫豫地从商非凡怀里跳出来。

嗡东亭示意妻子和儿子全都离远一点，并让两人把家中所有窗帘全都拉上。

还好他们现在站的位置，如果不是贴着窗户往里看，外面应该看不到他们家恩人的详细变化。

“没想到……”阿城呢喃。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 41: The Broodmother's Heart (Part 1)

Shang Feifan was entirely unmoved, and even looked somewhat repulsed. "You can auction it off. If that baron wants this thing, he will naturally spend money to buy it, which can also be considered compensation for your family's losses. At the same time, it will lift any future worries from your shoulders."

Weng Dongting shook his head, took the pitch-black cylinder from his son's hand, flicked his fingernail, and suddenly slashed across his own palm.

Fresh blood welled out.

Weng Dongting pressed the cylinder against his bleeding palm.

A Cheng and Mother Weng both looked at him in astonishment.

After waiting for a moment, Weng Dongting said to Shang Feifan, "You see, this thing has no reaction to me whatsoever."

Weng Dongting then shoved the cylinder to Mother Weng, letting her try it as well.

Mother Weng looked at her husband, sliced her own palm, and repeated the process, yet the pitch-black cylinder still remained completely unresponsive.

Weng Dongting took back the cylinder, handed it once more to Shang Feifan, and said with utmost sincerity, "Our whole family has tried it. This thing clearly has no affinity with us. Even if we give it to you, we will not regret it. If, as you suggested, we were to auction this thing off or present it to the baron, we have no way to prove that Nellie actually gave this to my son, and that baron would never believe it. Unless he and his sons could resonate with this thing—though if that were truly the case, I'd probably die of anger."

The corners of Shang Feifan’s mouth curled slightly. He could understand the Weng family's sentiment: what they could not obtain themselves, they certainly did not want to benefit their enemies.

Weng Dongting continued, "Previously, I didn't know such an item existed. I thought whoever had someone steal all my son's luggage and turn him into a slave in a bandit den was merely doing it to torture him. But now... torture is probably only one of their motives. I suspect that person might also have been searching for this object, and deliberately imprisoned A Cheng in the bandit den just to observe whether he had awakened any divine bloodline talents."

"That person probably searched our house too, but found nothing. And my son had never spoken of this matter to anyone else, so the culprit likely only had suspicions and wasn't certain whether Nellie truly gave the item to A Cheng. After Nellie died, A Cheng buried her in the northern public cemetery, but if my guess is right, Nellie's corpse is probably no longer in her grave."

A Cheng's lips trembled. He still held genuine affection for Nellie, and hearing that she could not even rest in peace after death instantly ignited a surge of anger and profound grief in his heart.

Why was he just a nobody? Why couldn't he possess formidable strength, rendering him powerless to protect his family or the person he loved?!

Weng Dongting patted his son reassuringly and placed the pitch-black cylinder directly onto the table before Shang Feifan.

"Therefore, if we were to send this thing to an auction right now, or present it as a tribute to that person, it would instead expose the secret that A Cheng did indeed obtain this item from Nellie. If the baron takes this object only to find it completely useless, given his paranoid nature, he would merely suspect that our family hid the real item and fobbed him off with a fake. That would only bring him down on our family's head—he wouldn't even hesitate to offend my teacher just to cause trouble for us until he gets what he wants."

Looking straight into Shang Feifan's eyes with exceptional sincerity, and even a hint of supplication, Weng Dongting pleaded, "By taking it away, you are actually helping our family."

Shang Feifan sighed inwardly.

Since the Weng family had put it to this extent, he had no choice but to take the item with him.

Weng Dongting had even made all his family members try it just to ensure they wouldn't harbor regrets later.

Shang Feifan reached out and picked up the pitch-black cylinder from the table.

"Then let it be so. If that baron comes looking for trouble and demands this item from you, you can simply tell him that I took it."

Anyway, he was just a player, and trouble was essentially just a quest. If it were any other player, they would be begging for such trouble to come knocking.

Filled with gratitude and guilt, Weng Dongting opened his mouth, but could only manage: "If you ever have any needs regarding potions in the future, just come to me. As long as I can help, I will spare no effort."

Without closely inspecting the cylinder, Shang Feifan stood up while gripping the object in his hand. "I will come to visit again tomorrow."

"Alright, alright, alright." The Weng family once again stood up to see him off.

Just as they neared the door, Shang Feifan suddenly turned his head and said to A Cheng, "Remember: it was only me, Norman Horshil from Black Forest City. It has nothing to do with anyone else."

A Cheng didn't react at first, but then abruptly recalled the person Shang Feifan had encountered at the potion market. He understood—this was a warning not to drag that person into the mess.

A Cheng nodded heavily, indicating that he understood.

Weng Dongting stepped past Shang Feifan and gripped the door handle.

At that exact instant, Mother Weng and A Cheng let out simultaneous cries of alarm.

Weng Dongting turned his head to see their benefactor being enveloped in the blink of an eye by a layer of pitch-black substance resembling a coat of paint, spreading at a rather steady pace.

A-Dai was bypassed by the oil film and anxiously cried out for "Dad."

A Cheng immediately reached out, signaling him to hurry over.

Shang Feifan also noticed the changes occurring on his body. He saw it very clearly: this layer of pitch-black film was spreading outward from the palm of his hand.

Was this trying to make him cosplay Venom?

Just as this thought crossed Shang Feifan's mind, a chime rang out in his head.

【Adventure Quest! You have accidentally acquired one-ninth of the Broodmother's heart. Whether this is your good fortune or misfortune depends entirely on your choice. The Broodmother's energy is invading your entire body; you have only three minutes to consider and make a choice. There are three options:

1. Choose to fusion: Allow the one-ninth Broodmother's heart to transform your bloodline, evolving you into a true member of the Zerg race. Zerg abilities are diverse; first, you will gain a tenacious vitality similar to a cockroach, commonly known as being unkillable. Of course, this does not mean truly unkillable. Future mutations remain unknown. There is also a certain probability of transformation failure.

2. Choose to absorb the one-ninth Broodmother's heart: Allow it to assist in upgrading your already awakened bloodline talent. How many levels it can rise, and which bloodline talent it will upgrade, remain unknown. There is also a certain probability of upgrade failure.

3. Choose to convert the energy of the one-ninth Broodmother's heart: Allow it to help you awaken a new bloodline talent. The bloodline talent that can be awakened remains unknown. There is also a certain probability of awakening failure.

Warning! If you fail to make a choice within three minutes, the system will destroy this adventure encounter. Countdown begins...】

Shang Feifan: "..."

After a brief moment of contemplation, he chose to absorb the Broodmother's heart to help upgrade his already awakened bloodline talent.

Option 1 would turn him into a Zerg. But judging from how much the beastmen loathed the Zerg race, choosing this would immediately place him in direct opposition to all beastmen. He still wanted to make friends with the indigenous NPCs here, so naturally, he didn't want them to ostracize him.

However, players who loved going against the mainstream and enjoyed playing villains would probably find this option quite appealing.

In reality, since Shang Feifan was considered a villain in the mainstream world, he was actually quite tempted by Option 1.

Option 3 offered a sense of anticipation, but no one could predict what kind of bloodline talent would awaken. Statistically, the probability of awakening failure or acquiring some useless, bizarre talent was much higher.

Rationally checking his own luck stat, Shang Feifan chose the option most beneficial to himself without hesitation.

The moment Shang Feifan made his choice, that layer of pitch-black oil film rapidly engulfed his entire body.

The Weng family watched nervously as Shang Feifan stood frozen in place.

A-Dai refused to leave Old Shang, remaining snuggled tightly against his chest.

"Little fellow, come over here. Your dad might be awakening a bloodline talent right now; you'd better not disturb him."

Hearing Weng Dongting say this, A-Dai hesitatingly hopped down from Shang Feifan's arms.

Weng Dongting motioned for his wife and son to back away, and instructed them to draw all the curtains in the house.

Fortunately, from their current position, anyone outside wouldn't be able to see the detailed changes happening to their benefactor unless they pressed their faces directly against the windows.

"I never expected..." A Cheng murmured.

chunks.chineseText:
嗡东亭也面色复杂地叹息：“你和内莉藏了这东西这么多年，我和你母亲还划破手掌用血尝试，都毫无反应。结果人家只是握在手心里，就这么一会儿，就起反应了。这就是命啊！”

嗡母靠近丈夫，反而很松快地说：“至少是我们孩子的恩人得到它，不是别人。”

“是啊。”嗡东亭欣慰地笑。

阿呆不想被阿城抱着，就站在桌子上，仰头看着黑漆漆的老商。

半个小时后，商非凡身上的黑色油膜像是被吸收了一般，一点点从商非凡身上消失。

当最后一点黑色油膜从商非凡的眉心消失，商非凡睁开了眼睛。

【恭喜你，奇遇任务完成，你受到虫母死亡时残留在心脏中的强烈怨念影响，导致你的血脉天赋‘诅咒之力’异变为‘恶咒’，从此你将再也无法觉醒任何祝福类血脉天赋，也无法得到任何祝福buff的加成。但任何诅咒类debuff都将对你无效，并成为‘恶咒’的粮食。

等级从9/100升级到29/100。

注：为了避免你被诅咒的代价吸干，请尽快学习诅咒祭司的相关职业技能。当你无法支付足够的诅咒代价时，付出的将是你的生命力。考虑到这次情况特殊，游戏商城某些商品特意为你进行打折销售，请及时利用。】

【恭喜你，奇遇任务完成，你受到虫母天赋力量影响，你的血脉天赋‘力大无穷’从19/100升级到29/100。】

紧接着，就是任务二十的完成提醒，5个贡献点到账。

商非凡没管嗡家人的表情，他先打开了游戏商城。

然后就看到排在第一位的商品发出bilinbilin的光芒，就生怕他看不到一样。

【诅咒祭司】初级篇，原价200贡献点，现骨折价58贡献点！

而他现在正好拥有58个贡献点。

商非凡抬头，就看到嗡家三口表情复杂地看着他，羡慕居多。

“嗯，谢谢？”

嗡东亭快速道：“您放心，我们不会说出去。”

商非凡心想说出去也没事，但他只是点点头，抱起阿呆，拉开大门走了出去。

阿呆贴近商非凡的心脏部位，嗅了嗅。老商的气味有了一点变化，变得更危险了。

如果他是这时候碰到老商，绝对不会靠近老商还叫他爸爸，他只会跑得远远的。

狰爷从屋顶上跳下来，靠近商非凡时，突然往后退了一步。

商非凡：“……”

好在狰爷围着商非凡绕了一圈，似乎重新确定了商非凡的身份。但它的长脚很是嫌弃地戳了戳老商的肩膀，还发出了哒哒声。

“我还是我，只是血脉天赋有了一点变化。放心，应该对你们没有影响。”商非凡拍拍狰爷，抱着阿呆跳上狰爷的背。

“走，去药剂市场。”

希望虎不帅还在那儿。

虎不帅确实还在，他在等待投毒事件的调查结果。

除了他，其他受害者也都在。

巨虫尸体需要处理，所有人都同意就地焚烧。但受害者们坚持必须要等调查结果出来，找到凶手后，再进行焚化。

现在凶手已经找到，药剂市场正在和受害者们商量赔偿额度的问题。

狰爷记下了返回药剂市场的道路。

商非凡坐在狰爷背脊上，消化他刚刚斥巨资购买的诅咒祭司初级篇。

贡献点就此变零，他的炼金师计划又得往后顺延。

可他也不想被那什么恶咒之力吸干，只能买下他原本并不想买的职业技能书。

这本技能书刚买下来，相关知识就融入了他的大脑。

就跟之前他得到的那本精神力修炼法一样。

诅咒祭司初级篇所述内容主要分三部分：诅咒仪式，诅咒物品，以及诅咒代价。

而这三部分内容怎么看怎么邪恶。

比如诅咒代价中，除了诅咒仪式中当做代价支付的祭品，还有一种替身制作方法。

这种替身就是在诅咒祭司诅咒他人又不想付出相关代价时，用来替代自身的代偿者。

技能书还有介绍，说替身最好寻找能量强大者，或者运气特别好的人。为此还教他如何观察他人气运和能量多少。

商非凡并不打算给自己做一个代偿替身，但对于观察他人气运和能量多少的技能很是欢迎。

从游戏商城购买技能书的好处就是他不用实际去学习，只要实际去应用。用的次数越多越熟练，他的技能等级也能跟着提高。

不过观察他人气运和能量多少的技能，使用时会消耗一定精神力，无法长时间打开。

“不帅！”商非凡远远地就看到了虎不帅，跑近后就从狰爷背上跳下来。

虎不帅似乎并不惊讶商非凡的返回：“事情办完了？”

“算是。这边进展怎样？”商非凡一边问，一边打开观察气运技能，偷看虎不帅。

这一看，商非凡愣住。

虎不帅的气运值很……微妙，竟然是97（-96）/100。

如果单从数值上来看，虎不帅的气运应该非常好，但他的气运却挂上了debuff，导致他的气运值竟然只有1点。

再看他的能量，4767/5000。

能量值倒是很高。玩家达到十级，能量值满值才1000。如果按照玩家等级计算，虎不帅的等级应该达到了50级。

商非凡无法看到自己的气运值和能量值，但根据游戏系统显示的数据，他的玩家等级已经达到七级。

商非凡由此猜测他的玩家等级很可能和他赚到的贡献点挂钩，因为目前为止他一共赚到75个贡献点。

“……休息区负责食物的兽人被发现死在他的休息室里，同时在休息室里发现了剩下的毒-药，还有一封遗书。遗书上说他因为不忿要被辞退，加上生活不如意，才会想要报复性投毒，想要让市场管理人倒霉，而他自己也服食了毒-药自杀。治安官让药剂市场管理者负责这次的赔偿，药剂市场同意了，大多数受害人都已经接受这个结果，但是……”

“但你觉得事情不会这么简单。”商非凡接口。

虎不帅眼神产生一点波动，点头：“过于巧合。”

商非凡想到虎不帅那挂着巨大debuff的气运值，也搞不清楚是有人想要恶心他，还是他真的倒霉碰到了巧合事件。

“治安官是什么态度？”

“负责的治安官只想快点结案，你不知道他看到那封遗书时有多高兴。”虎不帅无奈道。

商非凡扯扯嘴角，“看来是我调查员身份发挥作用的时候到了。那负责食物的兽人尸体还在原地？”

虎不帅眼睛一亮：“在。不过药剂市场那边希望快点把这件事解决掉，只等和受害者们商讨好赔偿额度，就把所有尸体都处理掉，包括那个负责食物的兽人。”

“你看到尸体了吗？”

“没有。治安官不让人靠近。”虎不帅没说他一直在找机会靠近小木屋。

“那间劳工休息室在哪里？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 41: The Broodmother's Heart (Part 2)

Weng Dongting also sighed with a complex expression, "You and Nellie hid this thing for so many years, and your mother and I even sliced our palms and tried using our blood, yet there was zero reaction. In the end, he merely held it in his palm for just a moment, and it immediately reacted. That's just destiny!"

Mother Weng stepped closer to her husband and said with surprising ease, "At least it's our child's benefactor who obtained it, not someone else."

"Indeed," Weng Dongting smiled with relief.

Not wanting to be held by A Cheng, A-Dai stood on the table, tilting his head up to gaze at the pitch-black Old Shang.

Half an hour later, the black oil film on Shang Feifan's body seemed to be absorbed, gradually fading away piece by piece.

When the very last trace of the black film vanished from between his brows, Shang Feifan opened his eyes.

【Congratulations! Adventure quest completed. Affected by the intense lingering resentment trapped within the Broodmother's heart at the time of her death, your bloodline talent 'Curse Power' has mutated into 'Malicious Curse'. From now on, you will no longer be able to awaken any blessing-type bloodline talents, nor will you receive any buff bonuses from blessings. However, all debuffs of the curse category will be rendered completely ineffective against you and will instead serve as nourishment for 'Malicious Curse'.

Level increased from 9/100 to 29/100.

Note: To prevent your vitality from being sucked dry by the cost of your curses, please study the relevant occupational skills of the Cursed Priest as soon as possible. When you cannot pay the sufficient cost for a curse, it will draw directly upon your life force. Considering the special circumstances of this mission, certain items in the game store have been specially discounted for you. Please make use of them promptly.】

【Congratulations! Adventure quest completed. Influenced by the Broodmother's innate power, your bloodline talent 'Infinite Strength' has upgraded from 19/100 to 29/100.】

Immediately following this was the completion notification for Quest 20, crediting 5 contribution points to his account.

Ignoring the Weng family's expressions, Shang Feifan first opened the game store.

Right at the very top, the first item was flashing with a dazzling *bilinbilin* glow, as if terrified he wouldn't see it.

The Primary Chapter of 【Cursed Priest】: Original price 200 contribution points, now on a massive fire-sale discount for 58 contribution points!

And he happened to have exactly 58 contribution points.

Shang Feifan looked up to find the three members of the Weng family staring at him with complicated expressions, mostly tinged with envy.

"Um, thanks?"

Weng Dongting quickly chimed in, "Rest assured, we won't speak a word of this."

*Speaking of it won't matter anyway,* Shang Feifan thought to himself. He simply nodded, picked up A-Dai, pulled open the front door, and walked out.

A-Dai pressed close to Shang Feifan's chest area and sniffed. Old Shang's scent had undergone a slight change, becoming significantly more dangerous.

If he had bumped into Old Shang right now, he definitely wouldn't have gotten close or called him dad; he would have bolted far away.

Zheng Ye leaped down from the roof, but as it approached Shang Feifan, it suddenly took a step backward.

Shang Feifan: "..."

Fortunately, after circling around Shang Feifan once, Zheng Ye seemed to reconfirm his identity. However, its long legs poked disapprovingly at Old Shang's shoulder with a distinct *da-da* tapping sound.

"I'm still me, my bloodline talent just underwent a slight mutation. Don't worry, it shouldn't affect you guys." Shang Feifan patted Zheng Ye and hopped onto its back while holding A-Dai.

"Let's go, to the potion market."

Hopefully, Hu Bushu was still there.

Hu Bushu was indeed still there, waiting for the investigation results of the poisoning incident.

Aside from him, the other victims were also present.

The giant insect carcasses needed to be disposed of, and everyone agreed they should be burned on the spot. However, the victims insisted on waiting for the investigation results to find the culprit before proceeding with the cremation.

Now that the culprit had been identified, the potion market management was currently negotiating the compensation amounts with the victims.

Zheng Ye remembered the route back to the potion market.

Sitting atop Zheng Ye's back, Shang Feifan digested the Primary Chapter of the Cursed Priest that he had just spent a small fortune on.

His contribution points had instantly plummeted to zero, setting back his alchemist plans even further.

Yet, he had no desire to be sucked dry by that dreadful Malicious Curse Power, leaving him with no choice but to purchase a skill book he hadn't originally wanted.

The moment the skill book was purchased, the relevant knowledge seamlessly melted into his mind.

It was just like the mental cultivation technique he had acquired previously.

The content of the Primary Chapter of the Cursed Priest was mainly divided into three parts: Curse Rituals, Cursed Items, and Curse Costs.

No matter how one looked at it, all three parts seemed thoroughly evil.

For instance, regarding the curse costs, besides the sacrificial offerings paid during curse rituals, there was also a method for crafting a substitute body.

This substitute was essentially a proxy used to bear the backlash instead of the caster whenever a Cursed Priest wanted to curse someone else without paying the corresponding cost.

The skill book even introduced a guide on how best to choose a substitute: preferably someone with powerful energy or exceptional luck. To aid in this, it taught him how to observe other people's fortune and energy levels.

Shang Feifan had no plans to craft a proxy substitute for himself, but he warmly welcomed the ability to observe others' fortune and energy levels.

The benefit of purchasing skill books from the game store was that he didn't need to study them practically; he could just apply them directly in practice. The more times he used the skill, the more proficient he became, allowing his skill level to rise accordingly.

However, using the skill to observe others' fortune and energy consumed a certain amount of mental stamina, preventing him from keeping it active for long periods.

"Bushu!" Shang Feifan spotted Hu Bushu from afar, hopped off Zheng Ye's back as he drew near, and trotted over.

Hu Bushu didn't seem surprised by Shang Feifan's return. "Are you done with your business?"

"Pretty much. How's the progress here?" Shang Feifan asked while activating his fortune-observation skill to take a peek at Hu Bushu.

At that single glance, Shang Feifan froze.

Hu Bushu's fortune value was extremely... subtle. It actually read: 97 (-96) / 100.

Judging purely from the numbers, Hu Bushu's luck should have been phenomenal, but his fortune had been hit with a massive debuff, dragging his net fortune value down to a pathetic 1 point.

Looking at his energy next: 4767 / 5000.

His energy value was remarkably high. When players reached level 10, their max energy value capped out at 1,000. Calculating by player levels, Hu Bushu's level should easily be around Level 50.

Shang Feifan couldn't see his own fortune and energy values, but based on the data displayed by the game system, his player level had reached Level 7.

From this, Shang Feifan deduced that his player level was likely tied to the contribution points he earned, seeing as he had amassed a total of 75 contribution points so far.

"...The beastman in charge of the food supply in the rest area was found dead in his lounge. The remaining poison was discovered inside the room alongside a suicide note. The note stated that due to resentment over being laid off, coupled with a miserable life, he wanted to enact revenge by poisoning the food to ruin the market management's reputation, after which he took the poison himself and committed suicide. The magistrate made the potion market management responsible for this compensation, and they agreed. Most of the victims have already accepted this outcome, but..."

"But you feel things aren't that simple," Shang Feifan cut in.

A flicker of emotion crossed Hu Bushu's eyes as he nodded. "It's far too coincidental."

Thinking back to Hu Bushu's fortune value laden with a colossal debuff, Shang Feifan couldn't tell whether someone was actively trying to screw with him or if he had genuinely collided with an ungodly run of bad luck and coincidences.

"What is the magistrate's attitude?"

"The magistrate in charge just wants to close the case as quickly as possible. You have no idea how thrilled he looked when he saw that suicide note," Hu Bushu said helplessly.

Shang Feifan twitched the corner of his mouth. "Looks like it's time for my investigator credentials to shine. Is the corpse of the food-supply beastman still where it was?"

Hu Bushu's eyes lit up. "It is. However, the potion market management is hoping to resolve this matter swiftly. As soon as they finish negotiating the compensation terms with the victims, they're going to dispose of all the bodies, including that food-supply beastman."

"Have you seen the body?"

"No. The magistrate won't let anyone get close." Hu Bushu kept quiet about how he had been constantly looking for a chance to sneak near the cabin.

"Where is that worker's lounge?"

chunks.chineseText:
“就在那边，我带你过去。”虎不帅带着商非凡快步走向就位于坐骑休息区旁边的小木屋。

小木屋门口有站岗的治安兵。

商非凡拿出他的调查员身份，治安兵不敢自己决定，就把负责的治安官给喊来了。

巧了，正是之前询问他们身份来历的治安官。

“我可以让你们进去查看，但是……”

“放心，我是个懂规矩的人。”商非凡拍拍治安官的肩膀，不容他推拒，就把他拨到一边，推开小木屋的门走了进去。

治安官碍于商非凡的身份，半推半就地就让商非凡进去了。看到虎不帅跟在商非凡身后，他也没说什么，但在两人进去后，他也走进了小木屋。

商非凡看到尸体的同时，也看到了这间休息屋的全貌。

这间休息屋很小，最多只有十个平方米，高度也只有三米。里面摆放的东西一目了然，除了一个简易柜子，就一张单人床和一张桌子一把椅子。

死者现在就躺在那张单人床上，嘴角和鼻孔都流出了乌黑的血迹。

虎不帅一进小木屋，就站在了尸体边，低着头像是默哀，实际是在聆听死者的呓语声。

等到治安官也跟进来，小木屋顿时显得拥挤不堪。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 41: The Brood Mother's Heart (Part 3)

"Right over there, I'll take you." Tiger Handsome led Shang Feifan at a brisk pace toward a small wooden cabin situated right beside the mount rest area.

There were duty guards stationed at the entrance of the cabin.

Shang Feifan whipped out his investigator credentials. Not daring to make a unilateral decision, the guards promptly summoned the officer in charge.

As it turned out, it was precisely the same bailiff who had previously interrogated them about their identities and origins.

"I can allow you inside to inspect, but..."

"Rest assured, I'm a man who respects the rules." Shang Feifan patted the bailiff on the shoulder and, leaving him no room for refusal, brushed him aside, pushed open the door to the cabin, and stepped inside.

Hampered by Shang Feifan's official status, the bailiff half-reluctantly let him pass. Seeing Tiger Handsome trail in right behind Shang Feifan, he didn't raise any objections either, but stepped inside the cabin right along with them.

The moment Shang Feifan caught sight of the corpse, he also took in the full interior of the lounge.

The room was tiny, spanning at most ten square meters with a ceiling height of just three meters. Everything inside was exposed at a single glance: aside from a simple cabinet, there was only a single cot, a desk, and a chair.

The deceased currently lay stretched out upon that single cot, dark, blackened blood staining the corners of his mouth and nostrils.

The instant Tiger Handsome entered the cabin, he stationed himself right beside the corpse. Bowing his head as if observing a moment of silence, he was actually listening closely to the deathbed murmurs of the deceased.

When the bailiff squeezed in after them, the small wooden cabin instantly felt cramped to the point of suffocation.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第42章 一路狂奔向反派的道路 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第42章 一路狂奔向反派的道路

商非凡忽然感到很舒服，就好像缺氧者突然来到了万亩绿地的天然氧吧，每呼吸一口气都让他感到身心愉悦。

右眼跳出提示：【怨气能量吸收中。】

下方就是一个进度条，进度条正在缓慢推进。

怨气？商非凡抬手揉了揉眼睛，他刚才进来就感到这屋里有点黑暗，之前他还以为是这屋子采光不好……所以这些飘浮在他眼前的丝丝黑暗，就是怨气？

叮咚。

【警告！受到黑暗能量影响，你正在吸收怨气。当你凝视深渊，深渊也在凝视你。黑暗能量吸收过多势必会引出那个藏在你灵魂中的黑暗的你。千万小心！】

商非凡：那我要怎么才能不被动吸收怨气？我已经想要停止，可这屋里的怨气还在主动朝我身体里钻。
